not_a_clearance: Each entry is a live defect, recorded as SEEN and not as resolved. Correcting an arm role is a published-number decision.

reasons.evolocumab-mixed-dyslipidemia-auto-full-: BERSON is an ADD-ON design: evolocumab plus atorvastatin against atorvastatin alone. Both arms carry atorvastatin BY DESIGN, and the shared background is what makes the contrast interpretable rather than what breaks it. Class C treats a shared agent as a dose/schedule contrast or a mislabelling; an add-on trial is neither. Recorded as SEEN so the class keeps firing on real dose contrasts -- netarsudil NCT02207621, where AR-13324 is in both arms and the true comparator is absent, is the defect this class exists for and remains baselined as live.

2026-08-28 hepatitis-b-taf-tdf arm-label.why: the arm labelled 'Open-label TAF' carried the TDF comparator's participants and posted percentages; the label was reconciled to TDF 300 mg and no count changed
